definition: Cloem is a company based in Cannes, France, which applies natural language processing (NLP) technologies to assist patent applicants in creating variants of patent claims, called "cloems".
details: According to the company, these "computer-generated claims can be published to keep potential competitors from attempting to file adjacent patent claims."
